base_image.name: inference-xpu-pytorch-opt:v0.5.17
base_image.note: registry path and digest unknown: read on ppu1 with docker inspect (N0.1 saw the tag only)

decisions: ray: the base has 2.31.0, Miles cc76e2391 requires >= 2.56.0. The image installs ray 2.56.0 (Miles floor). Not checked: sglang 0.5.17 with ray 2.56. The NPU sampler talks HTTP, not Ray, so the two images need not share a ray version.
fla: the base 1.0.0 is kept; Miles pins 0.5.2 plus a KDA patch. Compatibility of Miles glm5_next kda.py with fla 1.0.0 is the first PPU probe (N7.5).
TransformerEngine: recorded, optional. Megatron runs with TE by default; --transformer-impl local is the fallback (main agent 10-19). The PPU probe decides.
tilelang: optional; the DSA SparseMLA path needs it, its PPU support is unknown.
megatron commit: not pinned (Miles' image follows radixark/Megatron-LM miles-main); the build requires MEGATRON_COMMIT and records it.
compressed-tensors: recorded, not pinned, until the base's version is read (A-INF item 6 asks for a pin).
yeto: not installed as a package (pyproject pins torch < 2.9 and transformers 5.13); it runs from /opt/yeto/src via the release layer.
